entries.042789d7bfb26869: The [[term:annual-securities-report|annual securities report]] states that the group (the company and six consolidated subsidiaries) provides the facilities and functions required for airports through four reportable segments: Real Estate Business within Airports, Real Estate Business outside Airports, Infrastructure Business within Airports, and Other Businesses. Within airports, it leases office buildings, hangars and factory buildings, and also operates heat supply and water supply and drainage at Tokyo International Airport and New Chitose Airport. Outside airports, it also leases office buildings, shared housing and hotels, and sells real estate. Its main customers are airlines and airline-related companies, and three companies, Japan Airlines Co., Ltd., All Nippon Airways Co., Ltd. and Japan Airport Terminal Co., Ltd., account for 33.4% of revenue. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥36,792 million (up 18.2% year on year).

entries.446c257b0b11cf2b: For the fiscal year ended March 2026, operating profit was ¥6,719 million (up 50.3% year on year), ordinary profit was ¥7,126 million (up 53.9%), and net income attributable to owners of the parent was ¥3,479 million (up 34.9%). Ordinary profit was also boosted by increases in subsidy income and dividend income received. An impairment loss was recorded as an extraordinary loss owing to a review of building removal costs in the Haneda Airport Itchome District, but net income increased. Rental profit and loss on rental and other real estate was ¥5,073 million in the current fiscal year (rental revenue is recorded in sales and rental expenses in cost of sales).
entries.46b175cafd7ff69f: A reportable segment that leases office buildings, hangars, factory buildings and similar properties within airports, and the category with the largest revenue from external customers among the 4 reportable segments. The company is in charge of it. In the fiscal year ended March 2026, revenue was ¥17,291 million (up 2.3% from the previous fiscal year) and segment profit was ¥4,006 million (up 18.0%). The securities report says that rental income increased through revisions of the rental terms of existing properties and tenant attraction, which raised revenue. Profit increased despite large-scale repair work, helped by lower depreciation resulting from the impairment loss recorded in the previous fiscal year on rental facilities in the Haneda Airport Icchome district. In this fiscal year, an impairment loss of ¥1,647 million was recorded in this category following a revision of the building removal costs in the Haneda Airport Icchome district. The land, including the sites of the office buildings, hangars and factory buildings, is administrative property under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Land, Infrastructure, Transport and Tourism, and the company has received permission to use it from the Civil Aviation Bureau of the ministry; the permission is renewed every 1 to 3 years.
